name: Raffles Institution
summary: Premier local boys’ independent school — IP and high-stakes academic culture.
body: RI is a landmark local independent school. Expat families rarely enter via typical international admissions; eligibility, citizenship, and MOE pathways dominate. Included here so relocating parents understand the local top-tier landscape when comparing options for PR/citizen children.
waitlistNotes: Not an international open-enrolment school — MOE rules apply.
